import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 21;
    static byte[] ibuf = new byte[BUF_SIZE];
    static int ip = 0, ie = 0;
    static byte[] obuf = new byte[BUF_SIZE];
    static int op = 0;

    static int getChar() throws IOException {
        if (ip == ie) {
            ie = System.in.read(ibuf, 0, BUF_SIZE);
            ip = 0;
        }
        return ip == ie ? -1 : ibuf[ip++] & 0xFF;
    }

    static void flush() throws IOException {
        if (op != 0) {
            System.out.write(obuf, 0, op);
            op = 0;
        }
    }

    static void putChar(char c) {
        obuf[op++] = (byte) c;
        if (op == obuf.length) {
            try {
                flush();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean readInt(int[] x) throws IOException {
        int sign = 1;
        int c;
        while ((c = getChar()) < '0' || c > '9') {
            if (c == '-') sign = -1;
            else if (c == -1) return false;
        }
        x[0] = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x[0] = x[0] * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = getChar();
        }
        x[0] *= sign;
        return true;
    }

    static boolean readChar(char[] c) throws IOException {
        int ch = getChar();
        if (ch == -1) return false;
        c[0] = (char) ch;
        return true;
    }

    static boolean readString(StringBuilder s) throws IOException {
        int c;
        while ((c = getChar()) == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
            if (c == -1) return false;
        }
        do {
            s.append((char) c);
        } while ((c = getChar()) != ' ' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != -1);
        return true;
    }

    static void writeInt(int x) {
        if (x == 0) {
            putChar('0');
            return;
        }
        if (x < 0) {
            putChar('-');
            x = -x;
        }
        char[] buf = new char[20];
        int len = 0;
        while (x > 0) {
            buf[len++] = (char) (x % 10 + '0');
            x /= 10;
        }
        while (len > 0) {
            putChar(buf[--len]);
        }
    }

    static void writeChar(char c) {
        putChar(c);
    }

    static int modPow(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (int) ((1L * result * base) % MOD);
            }
            base = (int) ((1L * base * base) % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static class Bitset128 {
        long lo, hi;

        void setBit(int pos) {
            if (pos < 64) {
                lo |= (1L << pos);
            } else {
                hi |= (1L << (pos - 64));
            }
        }

        void clear() {
            lo = 0;
            hi = 0;
        }

        boolean equals(Bitset128 other) {
            return lo == other.lo && hi == other.hi;
        }

        boolean getBit(int pos) {
            if (pos < 64) {
                return ((lo >> pos) & 1) == 1;
            } else {
                return ((hi >> (pos - 64)) & 1) == 1;
            }
        }

        void or(Bitset128 other) {
            lo |= other.lo;
            hi |= other.hi;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return (int) (lo ^ (lo >>> 32)) * 31 + (int) (hi ^ (hi >>> 32));
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (this == obj) return true;
            if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
            Bitset128 other = (Bitset128) obj;
            return lo == other.lo && hi == other.hi;
        }
    }

    static class BitsetComparator implements Comparator<Bitset128> {
        @Override
        public int compare(Bitset128 a, Bitset128 b) {
            if (a.hi != b.hi) {
                return Long.compare(a.hi, b.hi);
            }
            return Long.compare(a.lo, b.lo);
        }
    }

    static Map<Bitset128, Integer>[] memo;
    static Bitset128 fullMask;
    static int n;
    static int[][] a;
    static int[][] f;

    static int dfs(int depth, Bitset128 state) {
        if (depth == n) {
            return state.equals(fullMask) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (memo[depth].containsKey(state)) {
            return memo[depth].get(state);
        }

        int result = 0;
        Bitset128[] nextStates = new Bitset128[11];
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            nextStates[j] = new Bitset128();
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            if (state.getBit(mask)) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << j)) == 0) {
                        nextStates[j].setBit(mask | (1 << j));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int choice = 0; choice < (1 << n); ++choice) {
            Bitset128 newState = new Bitset128();
            newState.lo = state.lo;
            newState.hi = state.hi;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if ((choice & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    newState.or(nextStates[j]);
                }
            }
            result = (int) ((result + 1L * f[depth][choice] * dfs(depth + 1, newState)) % MOD);
        }

        memo[depth].put(state, result);
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            memo = new Map[8];
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
                memo[i] = new HashMap<>();
            }

            int[] nArr = new int[1];
            readInt(nArr);
            n = nArr[0];

            fullMask = new Bitset128();
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
                fullMask.setBit(i);
            }

            Bitset128 initial = new Bitset128();
            initial.setBit(0);

            int inv100 = modPow(100, MOD - 2);

            a = new int[11][11];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    int[] val = new int[1];
                    readInt(val);
                    a[i][j] = (int) ((1L * val[0] * inv100) % MOD);
                }
            }

            f = new int[11][1 << 11];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
                    f[i][mask] = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                        if ((mask & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                            f[i][mask] = (int) ((1L * f[i][mask] * a[k][i]) % MOD);
                        } else {
                            f[i][mask] = (int) ((1L * f[i][mask] * ((MOD + 1 - a[k][i]) % MOD)) % MOD);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            writeInt(dfs(0, initial));
            writeChar('\n');
            flush();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
